title: Extract signals
description: The average of each ROI's pixels in every frame (frames x ROIs, in the order of the ROI file, without rejected ROIs), and of surrounding pixels outside every ROI, for neuropil correction. With excludeOverlaps, pixels in more than one ROI are left out of the ROIs' signals, as dev does. The neuropil is a ring that starts neuropilGap pixels from the ROI and is neuropilWidth pixels wide (square distance), or with neuropilMethod expansion, dev's: the ROI grown until the neuropil outside every ROI (and neuropilSeparation pixels around them) covers neuropilExpansionFactor times the ROI's area.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

rois.title: ROIs
rois.description: Variable that holds the ROIs, as ophys.detect_rois saves them.

output.title: Signals
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

neuropilOutput.title: Neuropil signals
neuropilOutput.description: Variable the neuropil signals are saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

excludeOverlaps.title: Leave out overlapping pixels
excludeOverlaps.description: Pixels in more than one ROI are left out of the ROIs' signals (dev's default).

neuropilMethod.title: Neuropil
neuropilMethod.description: ring: a ring at a fixed distance. expansion: dev's, grown to a multiple of the ROI's area.

neuropilExpansionFactor.title: Neuropil area (x ROI area)
neuropilExpansionFactor.description: For expansion: the neuropil's area as a multiple of the ROI's.

neuropilSeparation.title: Separation (pixels)
neuropilSeparation.description: For expansion: pixels around every ROI that no neuropil takes.

includeRejected.title: Include rejected ROIs
includeRejected.description: ROIs classified as rejected (in the viewer) are left out unless this is on

firstFrame.title: First frame
firstFrame.description: The first frame to process, from 1 (dev's frame interval): the method works on frames firstFrame..lastFrame only, and its outputs have that many frames.

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: The last frame to process; 0 for the last frame of the stack.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels (height x width x channels x frames): the one to use, from 1

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes (height x width x channels x planes x frames): the one to use, from 1, or 0 for every plane, one after the other, in one run
